primary: Number of free-window goal hits per original evaluation episode, retaining all zero-event and zero-discovery episodes.
secondary: Free-window progress and path length per original episode; descriptive per100free-update rates; whole-episode score, forced hits, event admissions and probe/brake telemetry.
contrasts: Within each network and vision branch: native minus ordinary, wrong+60, wrong-60, reset_after_glimpse, reset_every_blind. Positive native-minus-ordinary suggests predictive pulse usefulness; positive native-minus-reset suggests useful recurrent carryover. Neither contrast alone identifies circular dynamics.
uncertainty: 10000 paired bootstrap resamples of32environment slots, each retaining2episodes; fixed RNGseed148207. Descriptive95% intervals conditional on the checkpoint, no population-level or multiplicity-adjusted significance claim.
endpoints: Baseline and all four fixed stages; final endpoint primary for follow-up, no favorable checkpoint selection.
scope: One preselected original training-seed pair, trained in a prospective memory task. Mechanistic geometry/pulse/phase/behavior analysis separately frozen before results.
tests: Three tests pass: zero-event denominator, window-partition invariance, unmatched/duplicated episode rejection.
